I don’t think I have ever seen an invention that left me asking more questions.This walking car is the first functional prototype of something  Rosmar H which is the brainchild of Romanian inventor Adrian Roșca. The prototype recently surfaced online and got quite a bit of media attention but Mr Roșca has been working on this invention for more than a decade. 

So why does this car "walk" instead of moving like every other car out there? The car walks because vehicles move in a linear manner.
